info.title: Google Drive
info.description: NyxID-hosted Google Drive operations. NyxID injects the connected account's Google OAuth token.

get.summary: List or search Drive files and folders.

x-aevatar-tool.name: drive_list_files
x-aevatar-tool.description: List or search Drive files and folders.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Drive search expression, for example trashed = false.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return, for example files(id,name,mimeType),nextPageToken.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Support shared drives as well as My Drive.

x-aevatar-tool.description: Create file metadata or a folder. Upload file content with drive_upload_file.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return, for example id,name,mimeType.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Support shared drives as well as My Drive.

mimeType.description: Use application/vnd.google-apps.folder to create a folder.

post.summary: Create a Drive file with raw media or import HTML as a Google Doc using multipart/related metadata and content.

x-aevatar-tool.name: drive_upload_file
x-aevatar-tool.description: Create a Drive file with raw media or import HTML as a Google Doc using multipart/related metadata and content. For HTTP/CLI multipart requests set Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary=nyxid_google_doc and send JSON File metadata first, then text/html content. Set metadata mimeType to application/vnd.google-apps.document for the HTML Google Doc import. POST imports a new document; use docs_batch_update_document for targeted edits after creation. The generated MCP tool supports only uploadType=media with a base64 body and application/octet-stream.

parameters.name: uploadType
parameters.description: media sends raw content with the request Content-Type identifying the content type. multipart sends multipart/related with a boundary parameter, JSON File metadata as the first part, and content with its own Content-Type as the second part. MCP supports media only.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return, for example id,name,mimeType.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Support shared drives as well as My Drive.

schema.description: Raw file bytes. MCP callers supply the binary body using the tool's base64 encoding.

For HTTP/CLI multipart requests set Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary=nyxid_google_doc and send JSON File metadata first, then text/html content. Set metadata mimeType to application/vnd.google-apps.document for the HTML Google Doc import. POST imports a new document; use docs_batch_update_document for targeted edits after creation. The generated MCP tool supports only uploadType=media with a base64 body and application/octet-stream. POST File metadata may optionally include parents to select a folder.
schema.example:
--nyxid_google_doc Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8 {"name":"Imported document","mimeType":"application/vnd.google-apps.document"} --nyxid_google_doc Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

Imported document

Hello from NyxID.

--nyxid_google_doc--

patch.summary: Replace Drive file content with raw media or replace a Google Doc by importing HTML using multipart/related metadata and content.

x-aevatar-tool.name: drive_upload_file_content
x-aevatar-tool.description: Replace Drive file content with raw media or replace a Google Doc by importing HTML using multipart/related metadata and content. For HTTP/CLI multipart requests set Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary=nyxid_google_doc and send JSON File metadata first, then text/html content. Set metadata mimeType to application/vnd.google-apps.document for the HTML Google Doc import. This replaces the whole document; use docs_batch_update_document for targeted edits. The generated MCP tool supports only uploadType=media with a base64 body and application/octet-stream. Move files using addParents/removeParents on drive_update_file, not parents in PATCH metadata.

parameters.name: uploadType
parameters.description: media sends raw content with the request Content-Type identifying the content type. multipart sends multipart/related with a boundary parameter, JSON File metadata as the first part, and content with its own Content-Type as the second part. MCP supports media only.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return, for example id,name,mimeType.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Support shared drives as well as My Drive.
